The [North American](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_America "North America") country of [Mexico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mexico "Mexico") regularly experiences [tropical cyclones](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tropical_cyclone "Tropical cyclone") from both the [Atlantic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atlantic_Ocean "Atlantic Ocean") and the [Pacific](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pacific_Ocean "Pacific Ocean") oceans. Tropical cyclones that produce [maximum sustained winds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maximum_sustained_wind "Maximum sustained wind") of more than 119[kilometre per hour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kilometre_per_hour "Kilometre per hour") (74[mph](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miles_per_hour "Miles per hour")) are designated as hurricanes, which can produce deadly and damaging effects, particularly where they make [landfall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Landfall "Landfall"), or move ashore. Hurricane strength has been ranked using the [Saffir-Simpson scale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saffir-Simpson_scale "Saffir-Simpson scale") since 1972, from a minimal hurricane as a Category 1 to the most powerful as a Category 5. The most recent Category 5 hurricane to hit Mexico was [Hurricane Otis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hurricane_Otis "Hurricane Otis") in 2023, which was also the costliest Mexican hurricane.

## Climatology

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_Mexico_hurricanes&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Climatology")]

From 1951 to 2000, [Pacific hurricanes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pacific_hurricanes "Pacific hurricanes") most frequently struck the northwestern Mexican states Baja California Sur or Sinaloa, as well as Michoacán in southern Mexico. [Atlantic hurricanes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atlantic_hurricanes "Atlantic hurricanes") during the same period were most likely to hit Quintana Roo along the eastern Yucatán peninsula and Veracruz along the [Bay of Campeche](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bay_of_Campeche "Bay of Campeche"). Along both coasts, the month with the most landfalls was September, although they can occur as early as May.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Mexico_hurricanes#cite_note-1)
